moat_against: Customer-capex cyclicality — ATS peak cycle guided to moderate in FY2027
Latest growth concentrated in ATS; other segments flat on EBITDA in Q3 FY2026
Acquisition-dependent growth (Atrion, ARAG, CyberOptics) with integration risk
No network effects or owned platform; technology lead must be re-earned
Acquisition debt — interest expense rose in FY2025 on higher average debt
moat_for: Proprietary dispensing/process technology specified into customer lines
Validation and requalification switching costs, especially medical and electronics
Recurring parts, service and consumables on the installed base
Proven pricing power — high segment margins held through cycles
Global service footprint across diversified end markets
moat_justification: Proprietary precision-dispensing process technology specified and validated into customer production lines — swapping risks revalidation and downtime in medical/electronics, making the installed base sticky with recurring parts/service/consumables and durable high segment margins. Not wide: no network effects, customer-capex cyclical demand (ATS guided to moderate in FY2027 after a peak cycle), acquisition-dependent growth with leverage, and competition from larger diversified industrials and niche specialists.
name: NORDSON CORPORATION
one_liner: High-quality precision-dispensing compounder, moat 7/10 — but at $328.80 it does not clear 15% in any scenario (weighted IRR 7.65%, weighted IV@15% $128.21; clears 15% only at ~$128).
